items.t: T6 automatic transmission failure
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $3,500.

items.t: AWD angle gear (transfer case) leaks or fails
items.job: Reseal angle gear (replacement unit if worn)
items.note: A replacement angle gear costs roughly $1,000-2,000 more in parts.

items.t: Worn front control arm bushings
items.job: Replace front lower control arms (pair) and align

items.t: Clogged crankcase breather causes whine and oil leaks
items.job: Replace crankcase breather oil trap and hoses

items.t: Tires wear out early
items.job: Four-wheel alignment and new tires
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $1,700.

items.t: Outer tie rod ends can break (recall)
items.job: Replace outer tie rods with improved design

items.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel pump flange
items.note: Only cars registered in listed states were covered.

items.t: Wipers can stick in winter (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper arms and nuts

items.t: Rear seat belt anchors may not be fitted right (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair seat belt attachments

items.t: Starter cable terminal can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Adjust starter terminal spacing

items.t: V8 engine mount bracket can break (recall)
items.job: Replace engine mount bracket and bolts

items.t: Power steering fluid leak causes sudden heavy steering (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering oil pipes

items.t: Engine loses power while driving
items.job: Diagnose power loss and repair engine or electrical fault
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average near $20,000 when the engine was replaced.

items.t: Automatic emergency braking activates by mistake
items.job: Recalibrate camera/radar and update software

items.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water
items.job: Clear sunroof drains and reseal
items.note: Water-damaged electronics or carpet can push costs into the thousands.

items.t: Main or backup battery drains or fails early
items.job: Replace main or auxiliary battery and register it

items.t: Center screen or navigation unit freezes or fails
items.job: Software update or replace infotainment unit

items.t: Brake vibration from warped rotors
items.job: Replace front pads and rotors

items.t: Air suspension compressor failure
items.job: Replace air suspension compressor

items.t: Coolant hose can leak near the catalytic converter (recall)
items.job: Replace coolant bleeder hose

items.t: A/C drain hose leaks water into the cabin (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace A/C drain hose

items.t: Front passenger seat belt buckle can come loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace seat belt buckle

items.t: Side and curtain air bags may not work (recall)
items.job: Reroute air bag wiring and modify rear trim panels

items.t: Curtain air bag bolts and third-row belt parts can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace air bag bolts and third-row retractor

items.t: Automatic emergency braking may not detect obstacles (recall)
items.job: Update driver assistance module software

items.t: Fuel pump fuse can blow and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump fuse

items.t: Loose screw can lock the steering (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gear

items.t: Brake assist and ABS can lose function (recall)
items.job: Replace brake hydraulic unit

items.t: High-voltage battery can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Replace battery module and update monitoring software

items.t: Engine computer error can stop the engine (recall)
items.job: Update engine control software

items.t: Second-row seat belt bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten seat belt bolts

items.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
items.job: Software update

items.t: 12V battery critical charge warning or drain
items.job: Software update and battery test or replacement

items.t: Transmission performance reduced message
items.job: Update transmission control software

items.t: Center display stuck or unresponsive
items.job: Infotainment software update or display replacement
